module.description: This is top module of SRAM Controller for UCD

bitfield.description:
64 B Standard IP MMR block
0: STDIP MMRs do not exist
1:15: These MMRs begin at offset 64*STDIPOFF from IP base address

register.description: This bit field is used to select DTB mux digital inputs

bitenum.description: Enable Parity Debug. An address offset can be written to [PARDBG.ADDR] and parity errors will be generated on reads from within this offset

bitfield.description: Trigger Initilization. This bit will auto clear once initlization is complete
Indicate that bank is getting initialzed

register.description: Parity error check debug address setting

bitfield.description: Debug Parity Error Address Offset. When [CFG.PARDBGEN] is 1, this field is used to set a parity debug address offset. Writes within this address offset will force incorrect parity bits to be stored together with the data written. The following reads within this same address offset will thus result in parity errors to be generated.
Parity Error Address Offset. This holds the address offset that first generated the parity error and an interrupt is generated. This register is 'Clear-On-Read'
